name: akeeba/phpfinder
description: Locate the PHP CLI binary on the server

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the unit suite, then the Docker integration suite
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the in-process unit suite against fake PHP binaries (no Docker)
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the integration suite against real PHP CLIs in a throwaway Docker container (tests/Integration/docker/run.sh)
scripts-descriptions.test:windows: Opt-in, not part of test: run the library on a real Windows VM (tests/Windows/run.sh; needs WINDOWS_KVM_HOST or -- --host=HOST)
